svg.title: Run and turn lifecycle
svg.desc: A validated task launches an owned driver and app-server. Wait timeout leaves work active; attach collects it and steer adds guidance to the same turn. Terminal output is preserved, processes normally stop, then the final snapshot is delivered. An unknown descendant tree allows answer collection while retaining claims and deferring finalization. Explicit forced close can accept that uncertainty only after fresh identity checks and durable evidence. Known survivors still block. A sleeping finalized turn can continue without a redundant role.
svg.text: A turn outlives its waiter; continuation starts a new driver
